verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Paddle's broad multi-currency and 200+-country reach, and a specific local payment method (Pix recurring mandate for Brazil) was added, showing the platform does add local payment methods over time. However, there is no explicit documentation of Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL options being available through the same checkout integration. missing for 10: explicit mention/docs of Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirect methods, and BNPL support in checkout.
